fields.statement: The testscript Setup makes each script's $WORK its own Rhiza root and writes $WORK/rhiza.toml registering a project named repo at $WORK/repo (directly, not through rhiza project add), so the existing scripts stay unedited; the acceptance checks that rhiza root show in $WORK/repo sees project repo, and $NOROOT stays for the outside-a-root cases.
fields.wording: Register work/repo: make each script's working folder its own root and register the repo folder inside it as a project named repo, keeping the existing scripts unedited; the agent's option, picked by the owner

fields.statement: daemon-repo-session.txtar leaves the pass-unedited lists of testscripts-run-under-root and root-daemon-lock; root-daemon-rex-session's leaf owns rewriting it to assert rhiza-<registered name>, keeping its case that another REX_SESSION does not move the tabs.
fields.wording: Rewrite that script: take daemon-repo-session out of the pass-unedited lists and let the project-named session leaf own rewriting it, keeping the foreign-session case; the agent's option, picked by the owner
